Documentos de interés común para la información de la comunidad marítima. Coverage: Διεύθυνση Εκπαίδευσης Ναυτικών. The portal shows the English title as "A SZÁLLÍTÁSI KÖZÖSSÉG TÁJÉKOZTATÁSÁRA SZOLGÁLÓ DOKUMENTUMOK" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Διεύθυνση Εκπαίδευσης Ναυτικών. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
